data.one_liner: Cross‑platform WebSocket channel wrapper for Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified WebSocketChannel API that works on Android, iOS, web, and desktop. It wraps platform‑specific WebSocket implementations and exposes a StreamChannel interface with ready, protocol, and close details.
use_when: You need a WebSocket connection that works on both mobile and web
You prefer a Stream‑based API over callbacks
You want to customize the underlying HttpClient or set a connect timeout
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP requests
You need advanced features like automatic reconnection or message framing
You are building a server‑side WebSocket handler
strengths: Stream‑based API with ready and close details
Supports WebSocket status codes via status.dart
weaknesses: Limited to WebSocket only, no higher‑level protocols
